==Transportation==
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Draynor Village]].
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Twiggy O'Korn]].
*[[Spirit tree patch]] in [[Port Sarim]].
*[[Draynor Manor Teleport]] and run south to [[Draynor Village]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Air Altar]] and run south-east.
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] and run west.
